items.title: AI Product Owner, Solution Architect
items.team: Senior Project Lead, Data & AI division
bullets: Product ownership: client-side Product Owner for US healthcare and global publishing clients, owning AI, data and digital products end to end, from discovery, requirements and development through UAT, sign-off and production launch.

Team leadership: led cross-functional AI, web development, data engineering and BI teams, turning complex business and operational problems into AI product capabilities, PRDs, acceptance criteria and executable engineering backlogs.

Solution architecture: led product and solution architecture across Generative AI, AI agents, AI/ML, APIs, Google Cloud, data platforms, analytics and web applications, keeping technical decisions tied to product outcomes.
Roadmap and delivery: owned roadmaps, priorities, dependencies, risks and timelines across concurrent programs, with regular stakeholder and client communication.

Pre-sales and client engagement: led client discovery, solution scoping, proposals and product demos for AI, data and analytics engagements, explaining AI capabilities, value and technical trade-offs to business and client leadership.

Book publishing data & BI modernization: migrated 200+ ETL pipelines from Talend, Qlik, Snowflake and legacy systems to Google Cloud (Airflow, BigQuery), de-risked with parallel runs and reconciliation, and delivered Power BI Embedded with row-level security per distributor.

Medical care AI agents platform: Product Owner and Solution Architect for an AI-driven operations portal for a US healthcare client, shipping an end-to-end MVP first, with validation agents checking content before distribution.

Autonomous AI log monitoring: led the team behind a five-agent platform that turns production errors into a root-cause analysis and a reviewed, ready-to-merge pull request, with a token-cost circuit breaker, a reviewer-agent gate and human approval before merge.

Drug competitor identification: owned an LLM-plus-rules market-intelligence tool where AI-assisted discovery gives broad recall and verification against FDA data gives auditable, regulatory-grade accuracy.

items.title: Project Lead, AI, Data & Analytics Products
items.team: RDE, leading BI, data engineering and ML teams
bullets: Owned the product lifecycle for AI/ML and analytics products: requirements, solution design, sprint execution and stakeholder delivery.

Defined use cases for predictive analytics, recommendations, forecasting and NLP/OCR document processing, and worked with ML engineers on feature definition, model validation and interpreting outputs for the business.

Delivered a Medical Data Intelligence Platform (sales-prediction models, OCR document processing, Power BI reporting, data governance) and Workpod, a workforce intelligence platform (talent analytics, candidate-matching logic, real-time KPI dashboards).
Designed data validation, reconciliation and automation workflows for email and document processing.

items.title: Data Analyst, Product Analytics, Power BI & ML Analyst
items.team: Product analytics for the SourcePros ATS platform
bullets: Defined and tracked KPIs such as time-to-fill, submission-to-success ratio, recruiter productivity and client delivery efficiency.
Analyzed user and operational data with SQL and Python to find trends, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and turned the findings into product and business insights.
Designed interactive Power BI dashboards (DAX, data modeling) and built data pipelines and models that made reporting more consistent and accurate.
Applied ML for recruiter-performance prediction, hiring-trend analysis and forecasting, including preprocessing, feature engineering and model evaluation.

items.title: Graduate Trainee
items.summary: Selected through the campus placement program in the final semester of B.E. Computer Science. Early exposure to corporate workflows and client communication, then a deliberate move into core computer science, data and AI/ML roles.
